sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Shows switches in the Material 3 style with check and close icons.
Removes the highlight flash on tapped buttons and links.
Stores the local encryption key in the TEE instead of StrongBox. Prevents the Encryption error on devices whose StrongBox rejects the key.
Unlocks unlimited projects and removes upgrade prompts. Usage limits for models, messages and images still apply.
